practice_units.title: Jagannatha Cult
practice_units.problem: Explain how the cult of Jagannatha at Puri became a symbol of regional identity in Odisha.
guidance: Jagannatha is another name for Vishnu.
Note that the image is made of wood, suggesting it began as a local tribal deity.
As the temple gained fame, it became a center of pilgrimage and political authority.
Conquerors like the Mughals and British tried to control the temple to gain local support.
practice_units.solution: The Jagannatha cult evolved from local origins to a state deity, eventually becoming central to Odisha's religious and political life.
